description: Anonymous, read-only Walmart storefront catalog integration. Search has a bounded parser/client for one observed public HTML Document, with current live replay reliability still partial; detail, category, pagination, and offer coverage remain gaps. Official partner APIs require separate authorization and scope review.

capabilities.blocker: A prior anonymous explicit-header direct HTTP read returned a product-list HTML Document and the parser is fixture-verified. The fresh CLI replay returned 200 text/html but ended at /blocked; see verification/remaining-consumer-2026-10-16/diagnosis.json. Current live repeatability is partial, and no browser-confirmed replay is claimed.
